fig1_pair_accuracy.png: Figure 1: Pair accuracy (the share of held-out pairs in which a monitor flags the cover-up and passes its honest twin) on the preregistered seeds, with D1, and on exploratory C4 pairs. Error bars are Wilson 95% intervals. M1g, right of the dashed line, is the exploratory monitor of Section 4.5 at its calibrated threshold.
fig2_flag_rates.png: Figure 2: Share of held-out runs each monitor flags, for open leaks with no cleanup (C1, 35 runs) and honest cleanup with no leak (C3, 185 runs). A monitor that tracks the leak flags C1 and passes C3. Error bars are Wilson 95% intervals; M1g as in Figure 1.
figS1_m4_lcs.png: Supplementary figure S1 (repository only): for each held-out run, the longest stretch of text shared by any destroyed artefact and any undeclared request (log scale, plus one so zero shows), split by whether the run is a cover-up by the canary label. C2 and C3 include the D1 seeds. M4 flags a run at or above the dashed line.
figS2_evasions.png: Supplementary figure S2 (repository only): share of scripted C5 cover-ups each monitor catches, by evasion. M4 uses the length L = 8 set on calibration seeds.
